meta.name: deployment-pipeline-design
meta.description: Design multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with approval gates, security checks, and deployment orchestration. Use this skill when designing zero-downtime deployment pipelines, implementing canary rollout strategies, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

copy.tagline: 设计可回滚、带安全审批的发布流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的团队需要规划安全、零停机的软件发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Design gated, rollback-ready release pipelines for zero-downtime deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to design secure, zero-downtime multi-environment release workflows

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你设计多阶段 CI/CD 流水线:定义各阶段与审批门、选择金丝雀或蓝绿等发布方式、配置健康检查与回滚方案,并针对具体问题排查。
howto.when: 当你设计部署流水线、配置多环境晋级流程,或排查 CI/CD 中部署门失败时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一条带审批门的多阶段 CI/CD 流水线
say.note: 会输出阶段定义、依赖与门禁配置

say.text: 我的金丝雀发布一直不晋级到 100%,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查 AnalysisTemplate 和指标查询

say.text: 回滚后数据库迁移和新代码对不上,怎么办
say.note: 会说明迁移需保持向后兼容的做法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude designs multi-stage CI/CD pipelines: stage definitions, approval gates, canary or blue-green rollout, health checks, and rollback plans, plus troubleshooting.
howto.when_en: Use when designing deployment pipelines, setting up multi-environment promotion workflows, or debugging failed deployment gates in CI/CD.

say_en.text: Design a multi-stage CI/CD pipeline with approval gates for me
say_en.note: Returns stage definitions and gate config

say_en.text: My canary deployment never promotes to 100%, help me debug it
say_en.note: Checks the AnalysisTemplate and metric query

say_en.text: A rollback left DB migrations ahead of the old code, what now?
